232bdc0f3402ae54d45ec48bd856e03f420bca56.summary: GitHub-hosted indicator-of-compromise page for the MICROPSIA (APT-C-23) actor. It lists a YARA detection rule named for a 2018 sample, nine sample SHA-256 hashes and a delivery URL, and points to write-ups from Unit 42, Check Point and ClearSky. The latest commit is dated Aug 15, 2019. The page names no sectors, countries or CVEs and makes no hedges.

2346a33266d24548bea515a9fdca011e9e26d6c0.summary: This is a GitHub project README for a Linux tool named 3snake that captures password-related strings from running SSH and sudo processes on servers, aimed at rooted machines. It is a tool's own project page, not a threat report, so no facts are recorded.
